DashboardLayout.invite_body: Bring the people who review and decide into this workspace.
DashboardLayout.app_not_in_workspace: {app} is not in this workspace. Pick a workspace that has it above, or add it from the marketplace.

Dashboard.meta_description: Vocion helps teams build, manage, and scale their business with contextual intelligence.

Teams.title_bar_description: Who works for you, by team: each team’s lead agent, its roster and the one person accountable for it. Authored in workspace/agents and workspace/teams.
Teams.workspace_lead_description: Runs the whole workspace — briefs you by consulting the team leads.
Teams.owner_inherited_tooltip: Inherited from workspace default — set an owner on this team to override.
Teams.ask_quarter: Ask how the quarter is going
Teams.consults_partial: Consults {consulted} of {total} teams — a team without a lead can't be reached yet.
Teams.no_workspace_lead_body: Your teams report to you directly. Name a workspace lead to get one agent that runs the whole thing and briefs you.
Teams.no_workspace_lead_hint: Set lead: in workspace.yaml, or load the sample workspace.
Teams.no_lead_warning: No lead agent — this team can't be consulted by the workspace lead yet.
Teams.ungrouped_hint: {count, plural, =1 {1 agent isn't} other {# agents aren't}} on a team yet — they still work, they just don't report through a team lead.
Teams.empty_body: Teams group your agents under a lead and a named owner — the way you'd draw your org chart.
Teams.empty_secondary: or author teams in your workspace YAML
Teams.seed_confirm: Load the sample revenue workspace? It adds sample teams and agents to this workspace — nothing you already have is removed or changed.
Teams.no_owner_banner: Set a workspace owner so every team has an accountable person.
Teams.error_body: Something went wrong loading the org chart. Your teams are safe — try again.
Teams.boundary_gated: {count, plural, =1 {1 skill waits} other {# skills wait}} for your approval — drafted, never sent alone
Teams.boundary_none: This team has no skills wired yet.
Teams.rail_lead_missing: No lead agent yet — this team can't be consulted by the workspace lead.
Teams.rail_lead_missing_hint: Set lead: in this team's file, under the hood below.
Teams.members_description: The lead is the team's front door — it coordinates the others.
Teams.no_members_title: No agents on this team yet
Teams.no_members_hint: Add team: {slug} to an agent in your workspace to put it here.

Billing.current_section_description: Adjust your payment plan to best suit your requirements

CheckoutConfirmation.message_state_description: Your payment has been successfully processed. Thank you for your purchase!

Chat.model_fast_hint: Quickest and cheapest — for lookups and short answers
Chat.model_balanced_hint: The agent’s usual — the default trade of speed and depth
Chat.model_deep_hint: Most thorough — slower and costlier, for hard reasoning
Chat.thinking_high_hint: Takes its time on a hard problem
Chat.search_mode: Search only — retrieval, no model in the loop
Chat.autonomy_ask_hint: Every action waits for your approval in Review.
Chat.autonomy_act_hint: Confident, reversible actions run and show as done, with Undo. Anything risky waits for you.
Chat.feedback_note_placeholder: Tell the team what to change (optional)
Chat.feedback_saved: Thanks — the team reads this on its next cycle.
Chat.queue_placeholder: Queue a message… ⌘⏎ to send now
Chat.queue_held: The turn ended early — these were not sent.

Review.context_not_read: Context for this recommendation has not been read yet.

Marketplace.plugins_tab_description: What this workspace can turn on: a plugin bundles agents, skills, object types, pages and measures that compose under your workspace in one switch. Shipped in templates/plugins; turning one on writes one line in workspace.yaml and applies it.
Marketplace.agents_tab_description: Roles you have not hired yet: open a profile to see what an agent does before you add it to the team. Every agent works from uploads on day one — connect a system later to deepen it. Shipped in templates/catalog.
Marketplace.empty_body: Every agent in the catalog has been hired. To add one nobody shipped for you, ask the Automation Engineer to build it from something you already do by hand.
Marketplace.none_body: This deployment shipped without the agent catalog. Agents can still be authored directly in the workspace.
Marketplace.hire_failed: Could not hire that agent. Refresh and try again.

SignIn.title: Welcome back
SignIn.subtitle: Sign in to your workspace
SignIn.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
SignIn.google_denied: That Google account has no login here. Ask an admin to invite that email.
SignIn.failed: Sign-in did not work. Try again.
SignIn.invite_only: This instance is invite-only — ask an admin for an invite link to join.

TwoStep.challenge_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
TwoStep.recovery_body: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works once.
TwoStep.invalid_code: That code did not work. Check your app and try again.
TwoStep.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, =1 {1 minute} other {# minutes}}.
TwoStep.gate_body: Your account asks for a code from your phone each time you sign in. Setting it up takes a minute.
TwoStep.setup_scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app — Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or similar.
TwoStep.setup_manual: Can’t scan it? Type this key into the app:
TwoStep.setup_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
TwoStep.setup_failed: Setup could not start. Try again.
TwoStep.recovery_intro: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. They are not shown again.
TwoStep.profile_description: A code from your phone on top of your password, every time you sign in.
TwoStep.codes_left: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left — make new ones.} =1 {1 recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}
TwoStep.status_off: Off. Anyone with your password can sign in as you.
TwoStep.confirm_code_label: Current code from your app (or a recovery code)
TwoStep.account_require_label: Require two-step sign-in for everyone in this account
TwoStep.account_require_hint: Members who have not set it up do so at their next sign-in, before they reach a workspace.
TwoStep.account_require_on: Everyone in this account now signs in with a code.
TwoStep.account_require_off: Two-step sign-in is now each member’s choice.
TwoStep.setup_password_intro: Enter your password to set up two-step sign-in.
TwoStep.setup_reauth: For your security, sign out and sign in again, then set it up within ten minutes.

ForgotPassword.body: Enter the email you sign in with. If it has a login here, we will send a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sent_body: If {email} has a login here, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour.
ForgotPassword.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {minutes, plural, =1 {1 minute} other {# minutes}}.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.done_body: Sign in with your new password.
ResetPassword.invalid_body: A reset link works once and expires after an hour. Ask for a new one.
ResetPassword.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, =1 {1 minute} other {# minutes}}.
